commands.label: Go to next problem
commands.description: Jumps to the next error or warning in the current file.
examples: ]d → the cursor lands on the next problem in this file
commands.rationale: Neovim and LazyVim use ]d for the next diagnostic.

deviation.shadows: Vim ]d (show the #define of the word under the cursor, searching from the cursor line), which neither VSCodeVim nor IdeaVim implements
deviation.note: Clashes with the ]d and [d jumps of ideavim-anyObject when its letter d is enabled.

commands.label: Go to previous problem
commands.description: Jumps to the previous error or warning in the current file.
commands.rationale: Neovim and LazyVim use [d for the previous diagnostic.

deviation.shadows: Vim [d (show the #define of the word under the cursor, searching from the start of the file), which neither VSCodeVim nor IdeaVim implements
deviation.note: Clashes with the ]d and [d jumps of ideavim-anyObject when its letter d is enabled.
